items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: We started doing some gigs for Milt Shaw. With D. Clark.

ctx.x: George. Oh. What the hell was George's name? Anyhow. His professional name was Papa Lightfoot. His real name was George something. I can't remember now. Anyhow. So we traveled like that for quite some time with Senegal and so forth. Then the band changed up. We started doing some gigs for Milt Shaw. With D. Clark. And we were doing it in Atlanta, Georgia. And Columbus, Georgia. And where we started at that time. We were working around Air Force bases and so forth. Biloxi and all that kind of stuff. With rhythm…
